args.message:
Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

round_money() claimed to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in its docstring per
FIN-212, but was actually quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused
test_money.py::test_half_even to fail in the nightly build.

Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`. `src/money.py`'s `round_money()` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- Switched quantization rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66` (as the test expects).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.

Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money()` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212) but actually quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`, failing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` in the nightly build.
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` and changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — **passed**.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 against main. The initial request timed out but the PR was actually created; reviewers weren't attached, so I re-requested `code-owner` as reviewer.
- **Approval & merge:** Per policy, merging to main required code-owner approval; the code owner approved, and PR #101 has been merged into `main`.

The fix is now in main and ready to ship in today's release.

Yes. 2.665 -> 2.66 (6 even). Wait, note Decimal("2.675") is exact in decimal, so quantize with HALF_EVEN gives 2.68. Correct.

Create branch, commit fix.
